data.exact_reserve_text: In 2024 while the Property Risks experienced prior year reserve releases, the cyber book demonstrated reserve strengthening, arising from adverse development on older year risks.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of $4.367 million in 2024, representing a 17.49% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. This movement was mixed, with favorable development from Property Risks and adverse development (strengthening) from the cyber book, particularly on older year risks.
raw_causal_phrases: variability of prior year claims releases year on year
Property Risks experienced prior year reserve releases
cyber book demonstrated reserve strengthening, arising from adverse development on older year risks
data.data_quality_notes: Gross premium mix is derived from the 'Analysis of underwriting result' table which shows only 'Reinsurance acceptances' as a category for 2024. The narrative on page 3 provides a qualitative breakdown of underlying business types (cyber, property treaty reinsurance) but no quantified mix for 2024.
